name: Pericyclic Reactions and Photochemistry
description: Pericyclic chemistry: electrocyclic reactions, cycloaddition reactions, sigmatropic rearrangement, introduction of photochemical activation: primary photochemical process, Jablonski diagram. Cis-trans isomerization of alkenes. Photo-induced rearrangements of benzene, photochemistry in carbonyl compounds and nitrogen compounds, miscellaneous photochemical reactions.
